subject: Re: Interest from OpenLib — GitHub integration + demo
messages:
From: Sam Taylor <sam@openlib.dev>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interest in Redwood — GitHub integration questions

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for Redwood's self-serve trial (thanks for the great docs!) and I'm evaluating whether Redwood could replace our current inference tooling for some of our open-source project workflows. A few quick questions before we book a demo:

- Do you have a native GitHub App or webhook-based integration for repo events (PR comments / issue triage) or is it primarily API-based?
- How does permissioning work if we want to listen to PR events from multiple repos across orgs?
- Any guidance on running inference on public repos vs private repos in terms of cost / tokenization?

I'd love to do a short demo with someone technical to walk through integration options and to see how Redwood handles throughput for live PR event processing. I'm based in PST.

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
Lead Integrations Engineer
OpenLib

P.S. I attached a short doc with the kinds of event flows we care about (attached: openlib-integration-notes.pdf).

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Taylor <sam@openlib.dev>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood — GitHub integration questions

Hi Sam — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the notes.

Short answers up front: we support both API-driven webhooks and a lightweight GitHub App pattern (recommended for org-wide installs). Permissioning is handled by repo/org-scoped OAuth with token passthrough for private repos; we can walk through those details on the demo. For public repos cost is mostly driven by request volume and prompt length — we can show some heuristics in the demo.

I'd love to set up a 30-minute demo with one of our platform engineers and Jonas (our AE) to walk the technical flow and pricing implications. Here are a few slots I have open (PST):
- Tue Mar 3, 10:00–10:30am
- Tue Mar 3, 2:00–2:30pm
- Wed Mar 4, 9:00–9:30am

Or you can pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwoodinference.com/marissa/30

I looped in Jonas so we can cover pricing/committing options if this looks like it could scale. If you want a deeper integration deep-dive, I can also add Dev Patel (platform engineer) — let me know.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: openlib-integration-notes.pdf
